title: Pipe charts for Jobs folder uploads
description:
Pipe charts in PipeShare draw inspection observations from the WinCan database that belongs to the same project as the video. Desktop AutoSync stores that database under Jobs/{project}/DB/{person}/, while the video sits in a Videos folder next to it. The website only loads the folder you have open, so it never saw those databases and the chart stayed empty. Older jobs that keep the database directly in DB/ or beside the video still worked.

Opening a video now also lists that project's DB folder and each person's folder inside it, then uses the database found there. The chart still stays inside the current client and job. Video playback range requests are unchanged.

Who is affected: PipeShare in the browser on pipeshare.live and pipeshare.net. Hard-refresh, open the Jobs project, and play a video to see the pipe chart.
changeLog: Pipe charts find WinCan databases stored under Jobs/{project}/DB/{person}/.
The same project folder match still works when the database sits directly in DB/ or beside the video.
A video name with a WinCan id suffix still matches the inspection inside that database.
Charts do not search other clients or other jobs for a database.
